# BAD-023 — Update build/CLAUDE.md and admin-ci.yml for ci.yml's in-workflow change detector

## Brief
BAD-022 moved ci.yml's workflow-level paths-ignore into scripts/ci-changes.sh and made Gate a job in ci.yml. Two docs outside BAD-022's deliverables now describe the old shape and would mislead the next edit.

Evidence: build/CLAUDE.md § CI path filters says 'ci.yml is the other shape — a paths-ignore list, which already carries **/*.md' (the list now lives in scripts/ci-changes.sh as case patterns). .github/workflows/admin-ci.yml header says 'NOTE for whoever turns on branch protection: main has none today' (main is protected and requires Gate). admin/README.md 'ci.yml now ignores admin/**' is still true in effect but could name the script.
